gnList.title: Grama Niladhari Division List
gnList.requiredSelection: Please select Province, District and GN Division.

residence-certificate.label: Residence Certificate (Padinchi Sahathikaya)
documents: National Identity Card (NIC) (Original & Copy) or Birth Certificate
Householder Register (Gaha Samagamuwa / Household List)
Electoral Registry details (Voter registration number/year)
Utility bill (Electricity/Water) or Deed/Rent Agreement in your name
Passport-sized photos (if applying for NIC/Passport verification)

character-certificate.label: Character Certificate
documents: National Identity Card (NIC)
Residence Certificate or Household List entry
Police Clearance Report (if required for specific official submissions)
Recommendation letter from employer or educational institution (if applicable)

income-certificate.label: Income Certificate
documents: National Identity Card (NIC)
Salary slips / Pay sheets (for formal sector workers)
Certified bank statements (for self-employed/businesses)
Proof of dependents (Birth certificates of children, if applicable)

life-certificate.label: Life Certificate (Jiwathva Sitime Sahathikaya)
documents: National Identity Card (NIC)
Pensioner Identity Card / Pension number details
Senior Citizen ID (if applicable)
Person must appear in person (or provide medical proof if bedridden)

voter-registration-electoral-roll.label: Voter Registration & Electoral Roll Updating
documents: National Identity Card (NIC)
Birth Certificate
Household Register details
Proof of residency for at least 1 year at the current address (e.g., Deed or utility bill)

verification-birth-death-marriage.label: Verification for Birth, Death, or Marriage Registration
documents: For Birth: Hospital birth notification card, Parents' Marriage Certificate, Parents' NICs
For Death: Hospital/Medical Cause of Death Certificate, Deceased's NIC
For Marriage: NICs and Birth Certificates of both parties

tree-felling-timber-transport.label: Tree Felling & Timber Transport Permits
documents: Land Deed / Grant Deed (Sinnakkara Deed) or Survey Plan
Applicant's NIC
Boundaries declaration & neighbor consent statements (if close to boundary)
Timber cutting permit (if requesting transport permit)

animal-cattle-transport.label: Animal & Cattle Transport Permits
documents: Proof of livestock ownership / Farm registration
Veterinary Health Certificate for animals
Transportation vehicle details and destination address

event-public-loudspeaker.label: Event & Public Loudspeaker Approvals
documents: Written application detailing event date, time, and venue
Applicant's NIC
Venue owner's consent letter
Police station notification copy

social-welfare-application.label: Social Welfare Application Verification (Aswesuma, Pensions, Disability)
documents: Applicant & family members' NIC copies
Birth Certificates of dependents
Medical reports/certificates (for disability or chronic illness aid)
Proof of income or unemployment declaration

disaster-compensation-damage.label: Disaster Compensation & Damage Assessment
documents: National Identity Card (NIC)
Photos of structural or agricultural damage
Property deed or residency proof
Police entry report (for fires or human-made accidents)
